entry_points.text: Startup maps, returns SME status; SNP completes table/SVSM or fails; VC resolves CPUID; KVM splits IRQs/NMIs via FRED/IDT.
Mode test scans cards; SYSENTER/SYSCALL build frames; common return centralizes IRET.
Switch exchanges stacks; Xen classifies faults; paranoid switches AS/segments; NMI copies frame without exit work.
Compat SYSENTER/SYSCALL disable IRQs, swap base, sanitize flags, dispatch 32-bit; FRED shares prologue/dispatcher/epilogue.
VDSO picks image by build/compat/enable; vsyscall emulates after checks; CPU usability gated; IOAPIC registers with overrides.
GSI dispatches PIC then IOAPIC; LAPIC parses overrides with fixmap; sleep reuses hints; wake caches channel.

exports.text: Early boot validates placement, builds identity/kernel maps, folds mask, selects SME/SEV/SNP; SNP resolves CPUID and inits state.
Entry publishes 32-bit switch, SYSENTER, INT80 and 64-bit SYSCALL and common return symbols.
Syscall dispatch uses number-indexed tables with compat selection; misses fall back to not-implemented.
User-mapped VDSO delegates time, clock, cpu and robust unlock in 32/64-bit widths under versioned symbols.
Early patch writes kernel/module text serialized; VDSO faults map pages; MCE logs and converts firmware errors.
APIC installs first matching OEM driver; IOAPIC maps globals to unit/pin; GSI maps to IRQ with trigger/polarity/NUMA.
ACPI boot locates tables, parses MADT, wires PCI/console; e820 prints, NVS reserves, global lock ops; perf queries ratios.

hazards.text: Bad placement halts; remap failures terminate; enumeration stops on heap exhaustion; BIOS needs consent.
Entry mitigates predictor/stack/IRET/GS/NMI; base/BHB need fences; fatal on bad legacy/image; SGX rejects bad leaf.
Call swap mismatch aborts; bad vsyscall warns and signals on bad stack/seccomp; bootstrap refuses foreign, pins on mismatch.
CPU handoff waits one second logging timeout; after wakeup adoption further offlining forbidden and channel erased.

invariants.text: SME walk creates/clears missing tables, preserves present, stops on large leaves; startup halts on bad placement, sanitizes image.
SNP CPUID uses validated lookup, zero on miss; VC needs security leaf; activation skips without caps/opt-in.
Entries switch tables, select return by privilege, mitigate speculation; paranoid never returns to user; NMI uses stable/mutable copies.
SYSENTER sanitizes pre-IRQ; 32-bit narrows/clamps, needs user state else slow; 64-bit bounds-checks; bad FRED halts in kernel.
VDSO fixup needs clocks/alignment, vdso32 clamped; robust uses locked CAS; patch coalesces, validates, NOP-fills, fatal on bad width.
Relocs adjust out-of-block only; NOPs merged; cpu-bit clear cascades; MCE prep stores identity, pool limits, filters drop errata.
VDSO move rebases threads, one family per process; boot tracks ACPI/model/ISA; each IOAPIC owns closed global interval with defaults.
IRQ alloc gains IOAPIC type; pin reuses/allocates; hotplug validates; e820 orders highest-wins.

locks.text: Fast 32-bit enables IRQs across dispatch, disables on fault exit; robust uses only hardware locked op; VDSO install holds write lock.
One IRQ-saving spinlock guards IOAPIC version/size/ID with verify; ACPI mutex guards hotplug; dedicated mutex publishes invariance once.

state_machines.text: SME reuses present, stops on large; startup check/fixup/identity/sanitize; SNP checks then postprocesses; init params/blob/SVSM.
BIOS trial-sets with restore; VESA registers text/graphics; SYSENTER/SYSCALL choose fast/slow return; IRET faults synthesize frames.
Base saved always or via probe; NMI checks window/active/bounds; FRED routes by type; 64-bit tries native then extended; patching scans.
Vsyscall emulate/exec-only/none; MCE filters by vendor; MADT registers valid; topology rejects over-limit; IOAPIC claims entry.
Deregistration vetoes on sharing; LAPIC tries SAPIC then LAPIC; early/full mark APIC/model; wakeup maps once, waits clearance.

structs.text: SME context holds cursors/root/flags/bounds with large/small variants; setup pairs header with blob; SNP spans base/extended/topology/save.
Packed VESA stores far pointers/mode detail, needs signature/version/terminator; mode holds id/geometry, card holds retained callbacks.
Trap frames carry segments/stack/flags/IP; isolation selects user table; NMI holds active/mutable/stable; privilege in low CS bits.
Sysvec array indexed by vector offset, installable pre-setup; extable holds relatives; VDSO binds fault/move; IOAPIC domains sized by pins.
Sleep storage per-CPU address/control pairs; HPET records address with repair; perf levels and SCI choices defined.
